title: Hellotickets Scraper
description: Scrape tours, attraction tickets, and city passes from Hellotickets category pages. Provide a Hellotickets listing URL and collect structured travel data at scale.

startUrl.title: Start URL
startUrl.description: Optional Hellotickets city or category URL. If omitted while keyword or location is provided, the Actor searches the Hellotickets destination directory.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Optional keyword filter applied to listing titles, descriptions, providers, and collection names.

location.title: Location
location.description: Optional city, state, country, or locale filter. Without a URL, matching destinations are searched across the Hellotickets worldwide directory.

results_wanted.title: Maximum number of items
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of unique ticket or tour listings to save.
